items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: Who else in the band did you hit it off with? ... Freddy. Freddy Jenkins.

ctx.x: Who else in the band did you hit it off with?

items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Freddie Jenkins. Well, really, Freddie -- he just brought Freddie in for a little color here or there, didn't he? [INTERVIEWEE] But he could play.
